Chapter 1409 - 19: Three Methods

Chapter 1409: Chapter 19: Three Methods

The three Immortal Emperors did not know Lin Yuan’s true realm.

At the thirteenth level of time life, the level of realm is not directly visible.

For instance, whether a time life has comprehended its own Origin Dao... if it does not actively display it, it cannot be determined.

Normally, one can only judge through the strength of this time life. Lin Yuan’s previous strength was comparable to an Immortal King, coupled with the comprehension of the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao.

Theoretically, a First Realm Red Dust Immortal could not achieve these.

As for observing Lin Yuan’s past and future timeline? With the protection of a lord’s status, even an Immortal Emperor would find it difficult to grasp the full picture, and forcibly peeking would inevitably alert Lin Yuan.

Time lives are very wary of their own past timeline. If the three Immortal Emperors forcibly peeked into Lin Yuan’s past timeline, even if they could see what they wanted, it would undoubtedly offend Lin Yuan.

This would be somewhat not worth the loss.

As long as it’s confirmed that Lin Yuan was born in the Great Wilderness Origin World, that’s enough.

...

The three Immortal Emperors, despite being shocked that Lin Yuan was not originally a Second Realm Immortal King,

were only slightly shocked, and their true focus was still on the newly born Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

"This kind of Chaotic Origin Dao is more perfect than any Origin Dao I know, and not even inferior to those Innate Chaos Origin Daos."

The Immortal Emperor sitting on the right felt waves in his heart.

The so-called Innate Chaos Origin Dao is akin to the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao, the Chaotic Origin Spacetime Dao, such fundamental daos underpin the operation of endless dimensional realms.

In terms of pure power, these Innate Chaos Origin Daos might not match certain Chaotic Origin Daos comprehended by Second Realm Immortal Kings or even Immortal Emperors.

But they are certainly the most perfect, applicable to all dimensional realms. For instance, the Chaotic Origin Spacetime Dao, when further subdivided, is the Chaotic Spacetime Dao, and even further into Spacetime Dao, Space-Time Rule, Rule of Time, Space Rules, etc.

In any place in the endless dimensional realms, there are traces of the Chaotic Origin Spacetime Dao; it is incomparably perfect and influences every aspect, which is something those acquired-chaos origin daos cannot achieve.

And now the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao gives the three Immortal Emperors a similar feeling, akin to those Innate Chaos Origin Daos in terms of perfection.

"If using such a Dao to assault a Perfect Time Being, I wonder what the result would be..."

The Immortal Emperor sitting on the left had a slightly fervent gaze.

Whether one can become a Perfect Time Being depends on one’s own path, which is set at the beginning of cultivation.

Although there hasn’t yet been a Time Lord who successfully becomes a Perfect Time Being, and there is no standard for what path can step into the fourteenth level,

according to every Time Lord’s thought, one’s Dao must be as perfect as possible.

Now, the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao comprehended by Lin Yuan is the most perfect Chaotic Origin Dao the three Immortal Emperors have ever seen.

"Perfect Time Being..."

The Immortal Emperor sitting on the right was in a complicated mood.

Each time life’s Dao has been set, no matter how perfect Lin Yuan’s Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao is, it has nothing to do with them.

But if they could witness the birth of a truly Perfect Time Being, for Time Lords like them, it would be a hopeful sign, at least indicating the direction is right.

The ultimate pursuit of Time Lords is to break through great destiny and transcend all constraints.

And becoming a Perfect Time Being means being able to completely master their own destiny, achieving transcendence of all constraints.

"Which path of transcendence to choose is not something we can decide."

At this moment, the Three-Life Immortal Emperor spoke. He had been silently observing the operation of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

"Now let’s go meet Tianyuan."

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor said.

"Yes, it’s time to meet."

The two Immortal Emperors on the left and right nodded.

Originally, they planned to wait until Lin Yuan also became an Immortal Emperor before meeting him.

But now? Though Lin Yuan is not an Immortal Emperor, the three Immortal Emperors do not doubt that he is already not any weaker than an Immortal Emperor.

Without having comprehended his own Chaotic Origin Dao, he was able to achieve peerless Immortal King status, nearing the Immortal Emperor level.

Now that he has comprehended the Chaotic Origin Dao, and such a perfect Chaotic Origin Dao at that, the essence of his life has again transformed, stepping into the Immortal Emperor domain.

...

At the end of the immortal road where Lin Yuan stood.

Under the circulation of the black and white Yin-Yang Taiji Dao, the restraining pressure from the virtual world was all retreating.

"Is this my Dao?" Lin Yuan was joyful in spirit; the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao was the fruit of his labors since stepping onto the path of cultivation.

It is the embodiment of all Tao Fruits.

The physical body and spirit might have the potential to dissipate, but the Chaotic Origin Dao will not.

"Hmm?" Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly, detecting three immense consciousnesses descending from afar, immediately restraining the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

In the next moment, three figures appeared not far from Lin Yuan.

"Greetings, Immortal Emperors." Lin Yuan slightly bowed to show respect.

Though his current strength is perhaps at the same level as the three Immortal Emperors,

he admired their undertaking of opening the immortal path.

No matter the initial intentions of the Three-Life Immortal Emperor, such as cultivating peer-level powerhouses to jointly explore the virtual world,

the fact that they publicly shared the immortal path, the existence of the virtual world, and led many Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings to enlightenment, was indeed beneficial.

Countless Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings benefited.

Including Lin Yuan, who also gained much. If it wasn’t for the enlightenment of the virtual world, it’s likely the time he comprehended the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao would have been greatly delayed.
